facts.text: It was premiered as a standalone opera at the National Theatre Munich on 26 June 1870 and within the Ring cycle at the Bayreuth Festspielhaus on 14 August 1876.

facts.text: The story of Die Walküre is based on the Norse mythology told in the Völsunga saga and the Poetic Edda.
